# M0-b-03 — independent check (lane `check/M0-b-03`, flow flow-7, stage group 12)

Checker: Opus 5.5 in Claude Code on the owner's Windows PC under WSL2 (machine id
`wsl:Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-10900K CPU @ 3.70GHz:20cpu:16gib`, Node v24.12.0), 2026-10-06. This seat is not the item's
author. It ran no git command and changed none of the item's files. It planned its own probes and mutants. The
author's lane lines showed up in this seat's first lane-log grep, but they served as neither evidence nor a map: the
mutant set and the probes are this seat's own. The probes and mutants ran in this seat's mirror,
`~/maps-scratch/waves/check-M0-b-03/plat` (a copy of `plat/` with its own `node_modules`; `readlink` showed that
`@plat/layout` and `@plat/kernel` resolve inside it). Each mutant ran in its own copy `mut-<id>/` with
`--maxWorkers=1`. No timing was taken or judged.

## Verdict: PASS — no blocker; fifteen minor notes in `M0-b-03-notes.md`

Every listed test and every here-bar of the item is green and was shown able to fail. The item's interfaces are
present. Its deviations are declared in C-0237. The wider probes found no fault on honest input. The survivors of
the targeted mutants are off the listed tests' promises: they fall to M0-x-05's per-rung ladder coverage (C-0085),
or they are one equivalent mutant, or the probes showed the code right where the test is loose. Each is a minor note.

The here-bars:

* **T34-1's commit clause on the M0 (b) faces (PR).** `commit-clause.test.ts` runs 5 kinds × 3 faces. It is green. It
  replays every stop record's four uniforms from a fresh `cut.stop` stream keyed by the face's lineage, recomputes g and
  τ, and reads each stop block's kerb from the arena (not from the report). It asserts both outcomes occur, so it is not
  vacuous. Mutant K04 (cut.stop keyed by the cell instead of the face) is killed (7 tests red). CONFIRMED.
* **F-CUT's bars on 10⁵ faces.** The item's tests line and C-0237 (18) route the 10⁵ run to M0-b-04, whose own
  here-bar it is. This item asserts the per-face bars on its fixtures (stage.test.ts, commit-clause.test.ts). Probe 1
  widened the sample: 479 faces of the six fuzz kinds (concave and holed among them) at 30–300 m circumradius, each
  run through `runS8`. Results: 0 throws inside S8, 0 refused districts, at most **3** kernel calls on any face (0 → 54
  faces, 1 → 398, 2 → 23, 3 → 4), no face count decreasing, `checkCI` hard rows clean on every arena. The residue soft
  bound was exceeded on 24 small one-face districts, which is reported (note N-15). CONFIRMED on the sample. The 10⁵
  bar itself is M0-b-04's.
* **T39-1, T40-1, T41-1.** These are green in the near set, and the mutants below show each can fail. CONFIRMED.

No timing bar is this checker's: `splitFace` per cut is timing-phase.

### Probes (mirror only)

* **Probe 1** (479 faces, the six fuzz kinds at 30–150 m and 150–300 m circumradius) is reported under the bars above.
  Its rung (a) maxima were attempt 2 on 171 runs, 1 on 98 and 0 on 148, and its outcomes were 8 124 blocks, 7 683
  cuts, 60 slits and 37 courts.
* **Probe 2** (20 two-district runs, seeds 7–11 × prosperity 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6 / 0.9): no refusal, no unresolved face,
  `checkCI` hard rows clean. Every lane's two `Way.from` / `to` junctions resolve to one vertex, and every `T` vertex has
  degree ≥ 3 (0 violations). The portal bearings point into their district (0 wrong over 207). Findings N-1 (957 of 958
  blocks deep) and N-2 (181 of 361 spine treatments refused) are calibration and quality notes. Both fail safely and
  both are reported.
